about: native-bridge.md §4: namespace = hostId + "-" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8(origin + "\n" + userId), first 16 characters. origin = lowercased scheme (http or https only) + "://" + lowercased ASCII host + ":" + port unless the port is the scheme default; any path, query or fragment is dropped. Credentials, IPv6 literals, non-ASCII hosts and ports outside 1-65535 are refused (invalid_options). Computed in Node by embed/src/accounts/namespace-vectors.test.ts; PulseKitAccounts.swift must give the same namespace on a device.

vectors.name: case, the default port, a path, a query and a fragment normalise away: the same namespace as the plain case
http drops :80; the userId is hashed as its UTF-8 bytes, not normalised (a decomposed é)

deviceCases: setAccount with each vector (configure({hostId}) first) answers {namespace} equal to that vector's namespace, and Library/PulseKit/<namespace>/account.json holds hostId, serverOrigin (the normalised origin), label when given, createdAt and lastUsedAt, and no userId.
setAccount with the same account again answers the same namespace and changes nothing else.
setAccount(null), then listDrafts / getDraft / countDrafts / usage / pendingResults / open: each fails with no_account; acknowledge is a no-op; listNamespaces still answers.

Before any open: setAccount A, then B: listDrafts for B is empty (or B's own rows). After an open on A: setAccount B fails with restart_required (details.namespace = B), yet listDrafts now answers B's rows (never A's), open fails with restart_required, and setAccount A again works and opens.
setAccount or purge while a flow is open: busy.

PR1-era <hostId>-local with no drafts: the first setAccount deletes it (both roots). With drafts: it stays; listNamespaces reports it (serverOrigin "", active false, unsent = its draft folders); it is never adopted into the signed-in account; purge({namespace: "<hostId>-local"}) deletes it.
listNamespaces lists every Library/PulseKit/*/account.json namespace (A and B above), active only for the signed-in one.

purge() of the active namespace after an open: Pulse JS answers releaseLibrary first, then both roots go; with no namespace left, Library/PulseKit/.shared and the empty PulseKit folders go too (a container diff shows nothing of Pulse's).
Library/PulseKit is excluded from backups (isExcludedFromBackup), and files under a namespace are NSFileProtectionCompleteUntilFirstUserAuthentication.
